c6fee171-a59e-47a2-9733-bbecff21005a.name: Fact or Fiction
rules: Reveal the top five cards of your library. An opponent separates those cards into two piles. Put one pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard.

3a77dbe0-5ef3-47a0-9c0a-d2cde1a378cd.name: Radiation
rules: At the beginning of each player's precombat main phase, if that player has one or more rad counters, mill that many cards. For each nonland card milled this way, you lose 1 life and remove one rad counter.
